LanguageData.IRC_EnableHumanRaidsDesc: Conservatively replaces pairs of low-tier raiders with a stronger vanilla pawn kind from the same faction group. No combat stat buffs are added.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableMechanoidRaidsDesc: Promotes mechanoid models within the same vanilla group while preserving breachers and excluding mech bosses as budget fillers.
LanguageData.IRC_EnablePhasedMechanoidWavesDesc: For pure-role swarms using safe edge arrivals, holds excess vanilla-generated mechs for later waves. Breach, boss-led, center/random drop, grouped, and water arrivals stay vanilla.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableManhunterPacksDesc: Only uses a stronger vanilla animal with compatible behavior, speed, body size, armor, and abilities. Keeps the vanilla pack when none exists. No stat buffs are added.
LanguageData.IRC_EnableMechClustersDesc: Only compresses same-role mechanoids in the cluster sketch. Buildings, turrets, shields, problem causers, activation, and positions remain vanilla.

LanguageData.IRC_VerboseLoggingDesc: Writes the original and compressed pawn counts and costs to the game log.
